**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer)

The agreement contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination fee, so it sits at the **preferred** position and no redline is warranted:

- **§14 Termination (p0079)** — termination on written notice, services run to the end of the following month; no buyout, minimum-term charge or termination fee.
- **§5 Compensation (p0045)** — only ordinary monthly fees for requested Hosting/Support Services; the monthly minimum is a pricing floor, not a stipulated damages amount.
- **§7 Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail (p0049)** — an anti-spam covenant with no per-message penalty or fixed damages attached (the planner's concern here is unfounded).
- Text searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "damages" and "shall pay" surface no Customer-payable stipulated sums.

Noted for the record but not flagged under this rule: the minimum monthly amounts in §5(a) are left blank and are carved out of the documentation/charge-dispute rights in §6 — a pricing/audit point for the relevant commercial rule rather than an LD deviation.
